system.description:
4D shield. Reduces advantage dice for positioning by 2 (min 0). Max Lock dice = Power -3. May Push and Charge at short length. Two actions to drop.

Shields add their dice to Block and Counterstrike (the defensive half). With Shield Training they allow Block and Strike. VA reduces shield dice rolled to defend (minimum 1D). 1s count as damage to the shield (same quality rules as armor). Versus missiles in Fight: great shields +3 Ob, heaters +2 Ob, targets +1 Ob to be shot; in Range and Cover +1 Ob. Shields may be included in an armor kit at no extra cost.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 480
